## Review follow-through

For each accepted review finding fixed in this PR, add the guard or the standards line that would
have caught it, or say why not. The reviewer tags findings `[mechanizable: <check>]`,
`[standards-gap]` or `[judgment]`.

- [ ] `[mechanizable: ...]` findings: guard added (lint rule or check, with a ratchet baseline), or reason given
- [ ] `[standards-gap]` findings: standards line added, or reason given
- [ ] `[judgment]` findings: nothing to add
